item.title: Artifactory Vulnerabilities Under Active Exploitation Enable Authentication Bypass and Admin Access
item.description: Three Artifactory vulnerabilities under active exploitation enable authentication bypassing on Internet-accessible, self-hosted deployments, potentially allowing attackers to establish persistent administrator access in under five minutes. (1 source: infoq)
